utterances.speaker: Asha
utterances.text: We approved moving the API integration test to October 3. Ben owns the test plan and will circulate it by September 29.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: I can own the test plan. The vendor sandbox is still unstable, so the October 3 test depends on sandbox stability.

utterances.speaker: Chen
utterances.text: Maybe we should also replace the reporting tool this quarter.

utterances.speaker: Divya
utterances.text: No decision on replacing the reporting tool today. Keep that as a discussion item only.

utterances.speaker: Asha
utterances.text: Risk R-17 remains open: sandbox instability may delay integration testing. Divya will ask the vendor for a recovery date by September 27.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: The earlier decision to freeze interface changes is superseded. Small interface fixes are allowed if Asha approves them first.

utterances.speaker: Asha
utterances.text: Approved. Record that as the new interface-change rule and retain the old decision in history.

utterances.speaker: Chen
utterances.text: Someone should probably clean up the dashboard when there is time.

utterances.speaker: Divya
utterances.text: Dependency D-04 is the vendor sandbox. If it is not stable by September 30, escalate the October 3 test at the next governance review.

decisions.statement: Allow small interface fixes only with Asha approval

risks.statement: Sandbox instability may delay integration testing

dependencies.statement: October 3 integration test depends on vendor sandbox stability

conditional_followups.action: Escalate October 3 integration test at next governance review
